title: Influence via Fourier coefficients
statement:
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ be a Boolean function and fix a coordinate $i\in[n]$. Then the influence of $i$ on $f$ equals the sum of the squared Fourier--Walsh coefficients over all frequencies containing $i$:
\[
  \mathrm{Inf}_i[f] \;=\; \sum_{\substack{S\subseteq[n]\\ i\in S}} \hat f(S)^2.
\]
